top_signals.title: Alphabet Mulls Asia Bond Sale as AI Fears Fuel Global Volatility
top_signals.summary: Alphabet Inc. has had talks recently about potentially offering Hong Kong and Singapore dollar bonds, people familiar with the matter said, a deal that would test investor appetite in Asia after an AI selloff in global markets.

top_signals.title: New Zealand Dollar Climbs as Ruling Party Gets Election Edge
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s dollar rose after the incumbent National Party emerged from the weekend election with a path back to power, putting it in pole position to lead negotiations with minor parties.
